rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice for someone or something cut off from the outside world.

example.english: The hut on that mountain is cloistered and cannot even get a phone signal.
example.traditional: 嗰座山上嘅小屋與世隔絕，手機訊號都收唔到。
example.jyutping: go2 zo6 saan1 soeng6 ge3 siu2 uk1 jyu5 sai3 gaak3 zyut6 sau2 gei1 seon3 hou6 dou1 sau1 m4 dou3

rows.jyutping: zyu6 hai2 sau1 dou6 jyun2 ge3 N
rows.note: Use this for the literal monastic slice, describing a person or thing dwelling in a monastery or convent.

example.english: The cloistered nun prays every morning.
example.traditional: 住喺修道院嘅修女每日朝早祈禱。
example.jyutping: zyu6 hai2 sau1 dou6 jyun2 ge3 sau1 neoi2 mui5 jat6 ziu1 zou2 kei4 tou2

rows.jyutping: wan1 sat1 jap6 min6 zoeng2 daai6 ge3 N
rows.note: Use this for someone sheltered from ordinary life and therefore relatively innocent or inexperienced.

example.english: They are cloistered and do not even know how to take a bus.
example.traditional: 佢係溫室入面長大嘅少爺仔，連搭巴士都唔識。
example.jyutping: keoi5 hai6 wan1 sat1 jap6 min6 zoeng2 daai6 ge3 siu3 je4 zai2 lin4 daap3 baa1 si2 dou1 m4 sik1
